local function createSteamWisp(position:Vector3, color:Color3, size:number, lifetime:number)
    local wisp = Instance.new("Part")
    wisp.Name = "SteamWeaponTrailWisp"
    wisp.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    wisp.Anchored = true
    wisp.CanCollide = false
    wisp.CanQuery = false
    wisp.CanTouch = false
    wisp.CastShadow = false
    wisp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    wisp.Color = color
    wisp.Transparency = 0.55
    wisp.Size = Vector3.new(size * 0.3, size * 0.3, size * 0.3)
    wisp.Position = position
    wisp.Parent = workspace

    TweenService:Create(wisp, TweenInfo.new(lifetime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = Vector3.new(size, size, size),
        Transparency = 1,
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(wisp, lifetime + 0.05)
end

local function createSteamShockwave(position:Vector3, diameter:number)
    local shockwave = Instance.new("Part")
    shockwave.Name = "SteamBurstShockwave"
    shockwave.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    shockwave.Anchored = true
    shockwave.CanCollide = false
    shockwave.CanQuery = false
    shockwave.CanTouch = false
    shockwave.CastShadow = false
    shockwave.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    shockwave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 36)
    shockwave.Transparency = 0.55
    shockwave.Size = Vector3.one * 2
    shockwave.Position = position
    shockwave.Parent = workspace

    TweenService:Create(shockwave, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = Vector3.one * math.max(2, diameter),
        Transparency = 1,
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(shockwave, 0.35)
end

local function createGearPulse(position:Vector3, direction:Vector3, color:Color3, diameter:number)
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.01 then return end
    local base = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction.Unit)
    local radius = diameter * 0.42
    local lifetime = 0.2

    for index = 1, 6 do
        local angle = math.rad((index - 1) * 60)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * radius
        local y = math.sin(angle) * radius
        local tooth = Instance.new("Part")
        tooth.Name = "SteamPierceGearPulse"
        tooth.Anchored = true
        tooth.CanCollide = false
        tooth.CanQuery = false
        tooth.CanTouch = false
        tooth.CastShadow = false
        tooth.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        tooth.Color = color
        tooth.Transparency = 0.25
        tooth.Size = Vector3.new(diameter * 0.24, diameter * 0.075, 0.045)
        tooth.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(x, y, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle)
        tooth.Parent = workspace

        TweenService:Create(tooth, TweenInfo.new(lifetime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            CFrame = base * CFrame.new(x * 1.55, y * 1.55, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle),
            Size = Vector3.new(diameter * 0.32, diameter * 0.04, 0.02),
            Transparency = 1,
        }):Play()
        Debris:AddItem(tooth, lifetime + 0.05)
    end
end

GameHelper.CharacterGunFireS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(gun:Tool, endPos:Vector3, effectData)
    if not gun or typeof(effectData) ~= "table" then return end

    local origin = getFireOrigin(gun)
    if effectData.EffectType == "SteamBurst" then
        if origin and typeof(endPos) == "Vector3" then
            createTracer(origin, endPos, Color3.fromRGB(165, 48, 16), 0.3, 0.18)
            createTracer(origin, endPos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 192, 86), 0.09, 0.1)
            local delta = endPos - origin
            for _, alpha in ipairs({0.22, 0.42, 0.62, 0.82}) do
                createSteamWisp(origin + delta * alpha, Color3.fromRGB(255, 134, 52), 0.9, 0.2)
            end
        end
        local impactPosition = effectData.ImpactPosition
        if typeof(impactPosition) == "Vector3" then
            local blastRadius = tonumber(effectData.BlastRadius) or 12
            createSteamShockwave(impactPosition, blastRadius * 2)
            createSteamPuff(impactPosition, Color3.fromRGB(255, 115, 30), 18)
        end
        if typeof(effectData.HitPositions) == "table" then
            for index, hitPosition in ipairs(effectData.HitPositions) do
                if index > 6 then break end
                if typeof(hitPosition) == "Vector3" then
                    createSteamPuff(hitPosition, Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 55), 4.5)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif effectData.EffectType == "SteamPierce" then
        local hitDirection = Vector3.zAxis
        if origin and typeof(endPos) == "Vector3" then
            local delta = endPos - origin
            if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                hitDirection = delta.Unit
            end
            createTracer(origin, endPos, Color3.fromRGB(190, 104, 20), 0.48, 0.24)
            createTracer(origin, endPos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 184), 0.12, 0.16)
            createGearPulse(origin + delta * 0.35, hitDirection, Color3.fromRGB(255, 187, 54), 2.2)
            createGearPulse(origin + delta * 0.7, hitDirection, Color3.fromRGB(255, 222, 112), 2.8)
        end
        if typeof(effectData.HitPositions) == "table" then
            local hitDiameter = math.max(3.6, (tonumber(effectData.PierceRadius) or 2) * 1.8)
            for index, hitPosition in ipairs(effectData.HitPositions) do
                if index > 4 then break end
                if typeof(hitPosition) == "Vector3" then
                    createSteamPuff(hitPosition, Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 55), 5)
                    createGearPulse(hitPosition, hitDirection, Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 92), hitDiameter)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local STEAM_WEAPON_IDS = {
    [614] = true,
    [615] = true,
}
local NORMAL_STEAM_COLOR = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(220, 218, 205), Color3.fromRGB(160, 150, 135))
local HOT_STEAM_COLOR = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 178), Color3.fromRGB(216, 113, 38))
local OVERHEAT_STEAM_COLOR = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 218), Color3.fromRGB(255, 82, 28))
local activeHeatVisuals = {}
local playerBindings = {}
local visualHeartbeat
local heartbeatAccumulator = 0

local function getSteamWeaponId(tool:Tool?)
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return nil end
    local itemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    local itemId = itemLo and tonumber(itemLo.id) or tonumber(tool.Name)
    return STEAM_WEAPON_IDS[itemId] and itemId or nil
end

local function getPredictedHeat(player:Player)
    local heat = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SteamHeat")) or 0
    local state = player:GetAttribute("SteamHeatState") or "Normal"
    local updatedAt = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SteamHeatUpdatedAt")) or 0
    local coolStartAt = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SteamHeatCoolStartAt")) or updatedAt
    local ventEndAt = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SteamVentEndAt")) or 0
    local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

    if state == "Normal" then
        local coolingFrom = math.max(updatedAt, coolStartAt)
        if timeNow > coolingFrom then
            heat = math.max(0, heat - (timeNow - coolingFrom) * 14)
        end
    elseif ventEndAt > updatedAt and timeNow < ventEndAt then
        heat *= math.clamp((ventEndAt - timeNow) / (ventEndAt - updatedAt), 0, 1)
    elseif ventEndAt > 0 and timeNow >= ventEndAt then
        heat = 0
        state = "Normal"
    end
    return heat, state
end

local function destroyHeatVisual(tool:Tool)
    local data = activeHeatVisuals[tool]
    if not data then return end
    if data.highlight and data.highlight.Parent then
        data.highlight.Enabled = false
        data.highlight.FillTransparency = 1
    end
    if data.attachment and data.attachment.Parent then
        data.attachment:Destroy()
    end
    activeHeatVisuals[tool] = nil
end

local function updateHeatVisual(data)
    if not data.tool.Parent or data.tool.Parent ~= data.player.Character then
        destroyHeatVisual(data.tool)
        return false
    end

    local heat, state = getPredictedHeat(data.player)
    local active = heat > 0.05 or state ~= "Normal"
    if data.highlight and data.highlight.Parent then
        data.highlight.Enabled = active
        if state == "Overheated" then
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
            data.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 18)
        elseif heat >= 70 then
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.62
            data.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(236, 63, 18)
        elseif heat >= 40 then
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.78
            data.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 72, 20)
        elseif heat > 0.05 then
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.9
            data.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(148, 46, 13)
        else
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        end
    end
    data.emitter.Enabled = active
    if not active then
        data.emitter.Rate = 0
        return false
    end

    if state == "Overheated" then
        data.emitter.Color = OVERHEAT_STEAM_COLOR
        data.emitter.Rate = 46
    elseif state == "ManualVent" then
        data.emitter.Color = HOT_STEAM_COLOR
        if heat >= 70 then
            data.emitter.Rate = 38
        elseif heat >= 40 then
            data.emitter.Rate = 28
        else
            data.emitter.Rate = 18
        end
    elseif heat >= 70 then
        data.emitter.Color = HOT_STEAM_COLOR
        data.emitter.Rate = 34
    elseif heat >= 40 then
        data.emitter.Color = HOT_STEAM_COLOR
        data.emitter.Rate = 22
    else
        data.emitter.Color = NORMAL_STEAM_COLOR
        data.emitter.Rate = 10
    end
    return true
end

local function stopVisualHeartbeatIfIdle()
    if visualHeartbeat then
        visualHeartbeat:Disconnect()
        visualHeartbeat = nil
    end
    heartbeatAccumulator = 0
end

local function ensureVisualHeartbeat()
    if visualHeartbeat then return end
    visualHeartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        heartbeatAccumulator += dt
        if heartbeatAccumulator < 0.1 then return end
        heartbeatAccumulator = 0

        local hasActiveSteam = false
        for _, data in pairs(activeHeatVisuals) do
            if updateHeatVisual(data) then
                hasActiveSteam = true
            end
        end
        if not hasActiveSteam then
            stopVisualHeartbeatIfIdle()
        end
    end)
end

local function createHeatVisual(player:Player, tool:Tool)
    if activeHeatVisuals[tool] then return activeHeatVisuals[tool] end
    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end

    local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    attachment.Name = "SteamHeatVentAttachment"
    attachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, handle.Size.Y * 0.35, 0)
    attachment.Parent = handle

    local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    emitter.Name = "SteamHeatEmitter"
    emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
    emitter.Enabled = false
    emitter.Rate = 0
    emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.65)
    emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 3.2)
    emitter.Drag = 2
    emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(38, 38)
    emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-25, 25)
    emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
    emitter.LightEmission = 0.25
    emitter.LightInfluence = 0.25
    emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.62),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.65),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.1),
    })
    emitter.Parent = attachment

    local data = {
        player = player,
        tool = tool,
        attachment = attachment,
        emitter = emitter,
        highlight = tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Highlight", true),
    }
    activeHeatVisuals[tool] = data
    if updateHeatVisual(data) then
        ensureVisualHeartbeat()
    end
    return data
end

local function refreshPlayerWeapon(player:Player)
    local character = player.Character
    local equipped = {}
    if character then
        for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Tool") and getSteamWeaponId(child) then
                equipped[child] = true
                local data = createHeatVisual(player, child)
                if data and updateHeatVisual(data) then
                    ensureVisualHeartbeat()
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local stale = {}
    for tool, data in pairs(activeHeatVisuals) do
        if data.player == player and not equipped[tool] then
            table.insert(stale, tool)
        end
    end
    for _, tool in ipairs(stale) do
        destroyHeatVisual(tool)
    end
end

local function disconnectConnections(connections)
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(connections)
end

local function bindCharacter(player:Player, character:Model)
    local binding = playerBindings[player]
    if not binding then return end
    disconnectConnections(binding.character)
    table.insert(binding.character, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
        task.defer(refreshPlayerWeapon, player)
    end))
    table.insert(binding.character, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
        task.defer(refreshPlayerWeapon, player)
    end))
    task.defer(refreshPlayerWeapon, player)
end

local function bindPlayer(player:Player)
    if playerBindings[player] then return end
    local binding = {persistent = {}, character = {}}
    playerBindings[player] = binding

    for _, attributeName in ipairs({"SteamHeat", "SteamHeatUpdatedAt", "SteamHeatCoolStartAt", "SteamHeatState", "SteamVentEndAt"}) do
        table.insert(binding.persistent, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attributeName):Connect(function()
            refreshPlayerWeapon(player)
        end))
    end
    table.insert(binding.persistent, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        bindCharacter(player, character)
    end))
    table.insert(binding.persistent, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        refreshPlayerWeapon(player)
    end))
    if player.Character then
        bindCharacter(player, player.Character)
    end
end

local function unbindPlayer(player:Player)
    local binding = playerBindings[player]
    if binding then
        disconnectConnections(binding.persistent)
        disconnectConnections(binding.character)
        playerBindings[player] = nil
    end
    local stale = {}
    for tool, data in pairs(activeHeatVisuals) do
        if data.player == player then
            table.insert(stale, tool)
        end
    end
    for _, tool in ipairs(stale) do
        destroyHeatVisual(tool)
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(unbindPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    bindPlayer(player)
end"},{"id":502,"text":"local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))

local CampfireValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CampfireValue
local TimeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.TimeValue
local WeatherValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.WeatherValue
local PlayerAttributeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerAttributeValue

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
local _controller:Model = GameHelper:GetController()
local campfirePointLight:PointLight = campfire:WaitForChild("Light"):WaitForChild("PointLight")
local atmosphere:Atmosphere = game.Lighting:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Atmosphere",true)
local bloom:BloomEffect = game.Lighting:WaitForChild("Bloom")
local Sky:Sky = game.Lighting:WaitForChild("Sky")
atmosphere.Density = 0.4
-- local ColorCorrection:ColorCorrectionEffect = game.Lighting:WaitForChild("ColorCorrection")

local LightState = {
    daytime = 1,
    nightInCampfire = 2,
    nightLampOn = 3,
    nightLampOff = 4,
    snowstorm = 5, -- 暴风雪
    fullMoonNightInCampfire = 6, -- 满月圈内
    fullMoonNightLampOn = 7, -- 满月圈外开灯
    fullMoonNightLampOff = 8, -- 满月圈外关灯
}

local v_heat:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(campfire, CampfireValue.heat)
local v_isDaytime:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(_controller, TimeValue.isDaytime)
local v_isFullMoon:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(_controller,WeatherValue.isFullMoon)
local _curLightState = nil

local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1)

function setLightState(state:number)
    if _curLightState == state then return end
    _curLightState = state

    if state == LightState.daytime then
        atmosphere.Parent = game.Lighting
    else
        atmosphere.Parent = nil
    end

    local campfireColorRate = 0.8

    }
    local LightingPropertyTable = {

        Brightness = 2,
        FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192),
        FogEnd = 100000,
        FogStart = 0,
    }
    local bloomPropertyTable = {
        Threshold = 2,
    }

    local skyPropertyTable = {
        MoonAngularSize = 11
    }
    if state == LightState.daytime then

    elseif state == LightState.nightInCampfire then
        LightingPropertyTable.Brightness = 1.5
        LightingPropertyTable.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(54, 52, 68)
        LightingPropertyTable.FogEnd = 160
        LightingPropertyTable.FogStart = 30

        campFirePointLightPropertyTable.Brightness = 2
        campFirePointLightPropertyTable.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    elseif state == LightState.nightLampOn then
        local FogEnd = PlayerAttributeValue.fogEnd.Value + GameHelper:GetLampLightRange(LocalPlayer)

        LightingPropertyTable.Brightness = 1
        LightingPropertyTable.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(54, 52, 68)

        LightingPropertyTable.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(31, 30, 53)

        LightingPropertyTable.FogStart = 20

        LightingPropertyTable.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 255)
        LightingPropertyTable.FogEnd = FogEnd

        LightingPropertyTable.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(2, 21, 84)

function checkRefreshLight()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local FilmMode:ScreenGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("FilmMode")
    local newStats = LightState.daytime
    if character and character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm) then
        -- 在暴风雪中,优先级高于一切
        newStats = LightState.snowstorm
    elseif FilmMode and FilmMode.Enabled then
        -- 播放CG中
        if v_isDaytime.Value then
            newStats = LightState.daytime
        else
            if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                newStats = LightState.fullMoonNightInCampfire
            else
                newStats = LightState.nightInCampfire
            end
        end
    else
        if v_isDaytime.Value then
            newStats = LightState.daytime
        else
            local isAlive = GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character)
            if isAlive then
                if GameHelper:IsOnCave() then
                    newStats = LightState.daytime
                elseif GameHelper:IsInCampfire(character:GetPivot().Position) then
                    if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                        newStats = LightState.fullMoonNightInCampfire
                    else
                        newStats = LightState.nightInCampfire
                    end
                else
                    if GameHelper:IsLampLight() then
                        if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                            newStats = LightState.fullMoonNightLampOn
                        else
                            newStats = LightState.nightLampOn
                        end
                    else
                        if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                            -- 满月关灯状态
                            newStats = LightState.fullMoonNightLampOff
                        else
                            -- 普通关灯状态
                            newStats = LightState.nightLampOff
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    setLightState(newStats)
end

function fellTreesStart()
    setTipVisible("Tip_砍树",true)

    local campfirePos = _campfire:GetPivot().Position

    _campfireUI = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("Guide"):WaitForChild("Campfire"):Clone()

    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(campfirePos,100,overlapParams)

        local tree:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Tree)

        local treeUI:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("Guide"):WaitForChild("Wood"):Clone()

                _treeUIs[tree] = nil

        tree:GetAttributeChangedSignal("hp"):Connect(function()

function updateFogColor(fog:Part)
    local v_originColor:Color3Value = fog:WaitForChild("originColor")
    if v_isDaytime.Value then
        fog.Color = v_originColor.Value
    else
        fog.Color = Color3.fromRGB(83, 83, 83)
    end

function onGoundTagAdded(ground:Part,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local grid:Vector3 = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(ground, GroundValue.grid)
    -- local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid.X,grid.Z)
    -- local pos = Vector3.new(posX,0,posZ)
    local pos = ground.Position
    -- local isFog = (centerPos - pos).Magnitude > distance
    if GameHelper.FogEnable then
        local name = string.format("迷雾%s",ground.Name)
        local fog:Part = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
        -- 创建雾霾
        if ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ClearFog)  then
            if fog then fog:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Fog) end
        else
            if not fog then
                fog = _fogPrefab:Clone()
                fog.Anchored = true
                fog.Name = name
                fog.Size = fog.Size * Vector3.yAxis + ground.Size * CommonEnum.XZ - SIZE_OFFSET
                fog.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
                fog:SetAttribute("grid1X",grid.X)
                fog:SetAttribute("grid1Z",grid.Z)
                fog:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Fog)
                fog.Parent = workspace

                local v_originColor:Color3Value = fog:WaitForChild("originColor")
                if ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldGround) then
                    v_originColor.Value = Color3.new(1,1,1)
                else
                    v_originColor.Value = _fogPrefab.Color
                end
                -- CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(ground,fog,fog)
                updateFogColor(fog)
            end
        end
    end
end

function onFogTagAdded(fog:Part, connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    table.insert(connections,fog.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
        local character = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
        if character then
            GameHelper:ClearFog(fog)
        end
    end))
end

function onFogTagRemoved(fog:Part)
    fog.Parent = workspace
    fog.CanCollide = false
    fog.CanTouch = false
    fog.CanQuery = false
    TweenService:Create(fog,TweenInfo.new(1),{
        Transparency = 1
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(fog,2)
end

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

function checkPlayBossFightMusic()
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then
        return
    end

    local isPlay = false
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround) then
        local boss = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BullKing)[1]
        if boss then
            local v_sleep:BoolValue = boss:WaitForChild("Values"):WaitForChild("Sleep")
            if v_sleep.Value then
                v_sleep.Changed:Once(checkPlayBossFightMusic)
            else
                isPlay = true
            end
        end
    elseif character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround) then
        local boss = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.WildBoarKing)[1]
        if boss then
            local v_sleep:BoolValue = boss:WaitForChild("Sleeping")
            if v_sleep.Value then
                v_sleep.Changed:Once(checkPlayBossFightMusic)
            else
                isPlay = true
            end
        end
    end

    local music:Sound = SoundService:WaitForChild("Boss战斗")
    if music then
        if isPlay then
            if not music.Playing then
                music:Play()
            end
        else
            if music.Playing then
                music:Stop()
            end
        end
    end

end

CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround):Connect(checkPlayBossFightMusic)
CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround):Connect(checkPlayBossFightMusic)
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.BullKing):Connect(checkPlayBossFightMusic)

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local EffectHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EffectHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local EnemyHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EnemyHelper"))

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local BellValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.BellValue

function addUseTimes(animal:Model)
    local v_useTimes: IntValue = animal:FindFirstChild("听铃铛次数")
    if not v_useTimes then
        v_useTimes = Instance.new("IntValue")
        v_useTimes.Name = "听铃铛次数"
        v_useTimes.Value = 0
        v_useTimes.Parent = animal

        local IntimacyGUIPrefab:BillboardGui = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("驯服"):WaitForChild("IntimacyGUIPrefab"):Clone()
        local t_num:TextLabel = IntimacyGUIPrefab:WaitForChild("t_num")
        v_useTimes.Changed:Connect(function(value)
            local text = ""
            for i=1,value do
                text = text.."🔔"
            end
            t_num.Text = text
        end)
        IntimacyGUIPrefab.Parent = animal:WaitForChild("Head")
    end
    v_useTimes.Value += 1
    return v_useTimes.Value
end

function getIds(bell:Tool)
    local v_ids:StringValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(bell,"可驯服敌人ID")
    local ids:{number} = {}
    local strIds = string.split(v_ids.Value,",")
    for _,strId in ipairs(strIds) do
        local id = tonumber(strId)
        if id then
            table.insert(ids, id)
        end
    end
    return ids
end

function onTagAdded(bell:Tool,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local useTrack:AnimationTrack = nil
    local v_buddy:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(bell,BellValue.buddy)

    local ActivatedSound:Sound = bell:FindFirstChild("触发音效",true)
    local nextUseTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,bell.Equipped:Connect(function()
        if bell.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end

        local r = 15
        local beam:Beam = nil

        if not v_buddy.Value then
            beam = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("BuddyBeam"):Clone()
            beam.Attachment0.CFrame = CFrame.new()
            beam.Attachment1 = nil
            beam.Parent = bell:WaitForChild("Handle")
        end

        local ids = getIds(bell)

        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        useTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character, "rbxassetid://104248433730006") -- 砍动作
        useTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
        useTrack.Looped = false

        local closestAnimal:Model = nil
        local con = bell.Activated:Connect(function()
            local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
            if timeNow < nextUseTime then return end
            nextUseTime = timeNow + 1 -- 1秒使用间隔


            if v_buddy.Value then
                local buddy:Model = v_buddy.Value
                GameHelper.CallBuddyC2S:FireServer(buddy)

                local head:Part = buddy:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    EffectHelper:PlayAttachmentEffect("摇铃",head,1)
                end
            else
                if closestAnimal then
                    local times = addUseTimes(closestAnimal)
                    if times >= 5 then
                        -- print("驯服",animal.Name)
                        GameHelper.TameAnimalC2S:FireServer(closestAnimal,closestAnimal:GetPivot())
                    end

                    local head:Part = closestAnimal:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if head then
                        EffectHelper:PlayAttachmentEffect("摇铃",head,1)
                    end
                end
            end

            useTrack:Play()
            if ActivatedSound then
                ActivatedSound:Play()
            else
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("铃铛")
            end
            EffectHelper:PlayAttachmentEffect("摇铃",bell:WaitForChild("Handle"),1)
        end)

        local onClear = function()
            if beam then
                beam:Destroy()
                beam = nil
            end
        end
        v_buddy.Changed:Once(function()
            if v_buddy.Value then
                onClear()
            end
        end)
        bell.Unequipped:Once(function()
            if con then
                con:Disconnect()
                con = nil
            end
            if useTrack then
                useTrack:Destroy()
                useTrack = nil
            end
            onClear()
        end)

        while true do
            task.wait(0.2)
            if bell.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then break end
            if v_buddy.Value then break end

            -- 查找身边的动物
            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Animal))
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local checkedAnimals = {}
            local closestDistance = 999999
            closestAnimal = nil
            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(bell:GetPivot().Position,r,overlapParams)
            for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
                if not hit.Parent:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Animal) then continue end
                local animal:Model = hit.Parent
                if table.find(checkedAnimals,animal) then continue end
                table.insert(checkedAnimals,animal)

                local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLoByEnemy(animal)
                if not lo then continue end
                if not table.find(ids,lo.id) then continue end -- 不能驯服这个

                local distance = CommonFunc:GetDistance(animal,bell,false)
                if distance < closestDistance then
                    closestDistance = distance
                    closestAnimal = animal
                end
            end

            if beam then
                if closestAnimal then
                    local Attachment1Parent = closestAnimal:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local BuddyBeamAttachment1:Attachment = Attachment1Parent:FindFirstChild("BuddyBeamAttachment1")
                    if not BuddyBeamAttachment1 then
                        BuddyBeamAttachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        BuddyBeamAttachment1.Name = "BuddyBeamAttachment1"
                        BuddyBeamAttachment1.Parent = Attachment1Parent
                    end
                    beam.Attachment1 = BuddyBeamAttachment1
                else
                    beam.Attachment1 = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.Bell,onTagAdded)"},{"id":510,"text":"local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local MeleeCombatClient = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MeleeCombatClient"))
local newMeleeSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版近战判定")

local swingSounds = {"近战武器Swing1", "近战武器Swing2"}

local function onTagAdded(tool: Tool, connections: {RBXScriptConnection})
    local atkTrack: AnimationTrack?
    table.insert(connections, tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end

        local character = tool.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        MeleeCombatClient.RefreshCooldown(tool)
        local animation = tool:FindFirstChild("AttackAnimation")
        atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character, animation or "rbxassetid://104248433730006")
        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
            atkTrack.Looped = false
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack:Stop()
            atkTrack:Destroy()
            atkTrack = nil
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        local character = tool.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end

        local profile = MeleeCombatClient.GetProfile(tool)
        if not profile then return end
        local cooldown = profile.cooldown or GameHelper.SwordAtkCD
        if not MeleeCombatClient.TryBeginCooldown(tool, cooldown) then return end

        if not atkTrack then
            local animation = tool:FindFirstChild("AttackAnimation")
            atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character, animation or "rbxassetid://104248433730006")
            if atkTrack then
                atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
                atkTrack.Looped = false
            end
        end

        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack:Play()
            atkTrack:AdjustSpeed(2 * GameHelper.SwordAtkCD / cooldown)
        end
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(swingSounds[math.random(1, #swingSounds)], tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"), {
            SourceUserId = game.Players.LocalPlayer.UserId,
            SourceKey = "melee-swing-v2:" .. tool.Name,
        })

        MeleeCombatClient.BeginSwing(tool, character)
    end))
end

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon, onTagAdded)"},{"id":511,"text":"local startCFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 100, 0),Vector3.new(0, 110, 0))
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

local cd = 0
local t = 2
local cframe = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetPivot()
--startCFrame = CFrame.new(startCFrame.Position,cframe.Position)
startCFrame = cframe - cframe.LookVector * 50 + Vector3.yAxis * 20
local offset = cframe.LookVector * 12.5
--local endCFrame = cframe - cframe.LookVector * 12.5
while true do
	local dt = task.wait()
	cd += dt
	
	local curPos = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetPivot().Position
	local endCFrame = CFrame.new(curPos - offset,curPos)
	local alpha = math.sin(math.clamp(cd/t,0,1) * math.pi * 0.5)
	workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = startCFrame:Lerp(endCFrame,alpha)
	if cd >= t then
		break
	end
end

workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
script:Destroy()"},{"id":512,"text":"local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local EffectHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EffectHelper"))

local HEAL_HIGHLIGHT_DURATION = 0.8
local healHighlightPrefab:Highlight = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Highlights"):WaitForChild("CraftHighlight")
local activeHealHighlights = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function showHealHighlight(target:Model)
	local state = activeHealHighlights[target]
	local highlight = state and state.highlight
	if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then
		highlight = healHighlightPrefab:Clone()
		highlight.Name = "HealHighlight"
		highlight.Adornee = target
		highlight.FillTransparency = 1
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
		highlight.Enabled = true
		highlight.Parent = target
		local tween = TweenService:Create(highlight,TweenInfo.new(0.4,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true),{
			FillTransparency = 0.35,
			OutlineTransparency = 0.15,
		})
		tween:Play()
		state = {
			highlight = highlight,
			tween = tween,
			generation = 0,
		}
		activeHealHighlights[target] = state
	end

	state.generation += 1
	local generation = state.generation
	task.delay(HEAL_HIGHLIGHT_DURATION,function()
		if activeHealHighlights[target] ~= state or state.generation ~= generation then
			return
		end
		activeHealHighlights[target] = nil
		if state.tween then
			state.tween:Cancel()
		end
		if highlight.Parent then
			highlight:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name:string,target:Model)
	if name ~= "回血" then return end
	if not target or not target:IsA("Model") or not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	showHealHighlight(target)
end)

-- 吸血
EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name:string,sucker:Model,target:Model)
	if name ~= "吸血" then return end
	if not sucker or not sucker:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	if not target or not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	
	--创建特效
	local effPrefab:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):FindFirstChild("SuckBlood")
	local eff = effPrefab:Clone()
	eff.Anchored = true
	eff.Parent = workspace

	local startPosition = target:GetPivot().Position
	eff.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPosition)

	local maxTime = 0.5
	local t = 0
	while true do
		local dt = RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

		t += dt
		local alpha = math.clamp(t / maxTime,0,1)
		if sucker:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			local endPosition = sucker:GetPivot().Position
			eff.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPosition:Lerp(endPosition,alpha))
		end
		if alpha >= 1 then
			break
		end
	end
	eff.Transparency = 1

	game.Debris:AddItem(eff,3)
end)

-- 雷神技能
EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name:string,lastHitNpc:Model,hitNpc:Model)
	if name ~= "雷神技能" then return end
	if not lastHitNpc or not lastHitNpc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		lastHitNpc = nil
	end
	if not hitNpc or not hitNpc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

	local effectPrefab = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Lightning")
	local effect:Part = effectPrefab:Clone()
	local Attachment0:Attachment = effect:WaitForChild("Attachment0")
	local Attachment1:Attachment = effect:WaitForChild("Attachment1")
	local Beam:Beam = Attachment0:WaitForChild("Beam")
	if lastHitNpc then
		Attachment0.Parent = lastHitNpc.PrimaryPart
		Attachment0.CFrame = CFrame.new()
	else
		Attachment0.Parent = hitNpc.PrimaryPart
		Attachment0.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.yAxis * 30)
	end

	Attachment1.CFrame = CFrame.new()
	Attachment1.Parent = hitNpc.PrimaryPart

	effect:Destroy()
	local tmax = 1
	game.Debris:AddItem(Attachment0,tmax + 1)
	game.Debris:AddItem(Attachment1,tmax + 1)
	
	local t = 0
	while true do
		local dt = task.wait()
		t += dt
		
		local alpha = math.clamp(t / tmax,0,1)
		Beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(alpha)
		if t >= tmax then
			break
		end
	end
end)

EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name:string,character:Model)
	if name ~= "复活光柱" then return end

	--if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	
	-- 创建复活光柱
	local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local effect:Part = EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect("复活光柱")
	effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Torso.Position))
	effect.Parent = workspace

	while character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		local dt = RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Torso.Position))
	end
	effect:Destroy()
end)
